mechanism_narrative: The continued drop in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT, together with higher RESIDENTIAL time, indicates fewer daily trips into commercial areas. Over the next four weeks this should keep RETAIL_REC below the prior four-week average because fewer commute-linked visits translate into weaker retail footfall.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain at or below current levels but RETAIL_REC averages above its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp week-on-week fall in TRANSIT below its recent range suppresses incidental shopping trips and leisure stops near stations. Once TRANSIT is below -45, RETAIL_REC should decline further within two weeks unless another mobility category rebounds enough to offset lost station-area traffic.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -45 and stays there for at least one weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -37.3 to -50.0 in the last two weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains below -45 for a full week and RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next 14 days, the threshold mechanism is false.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and RESIDENTIAL rise together, discretionary time shifts toward local outdoor and home-based activity rather than retail venues. That substitution should push RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks, especially if PARKS remains positive while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped to 29.7 at t-2w before turning negative
failure_condition: If PARKS and RESIDENTIAL stay above their recent averages but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, the substitution hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES is a valid proxy for stricter movement controls or reduced office attendance. Under that regime, retail visits should weaken within one week because both commuting and after-work shopping channels contract at the same time.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -25 while TRANSIT is below -45
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES is below -25 and TRANSIT is below -45 but RETAIL_REC does not weaken within 7 days, the joint restriction effect is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS after a negative week signals a weather or season shift toward outdoor recreation. That shift can crowd out indoor retail and recreation spending, so RETAIL_REC should be lower over the next four weeks if PARKS stays above zero again.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses from negative to positive week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -2.3 to -2.6 after a prior spike
failure_condition: If PARKS crosses from negative to positive and RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior 28 days over the next month, the seasonal substitution claim fails.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently elevated GROCERY_PHARM combined with rising RESIDENTIAL indicates precautionary errand consolidation and more time spent at home. That pattern should depress discretionary retail visits over the next two weeks because households shift from shopping trips to essential-only trips.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL remain elevated but RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days, the consolidation mechanism is invalid.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of very low TRANSIT and low WORKPLACES marks a durable reduction in daytime city-center circulation. That should produce a slower but persistent decline in RETAIL_REC across four weeks because fewer people are present near retail corridors during both commute and lunch periods.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is at -50.0 and WORKPLACES at -29.4 in the latest week
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES stay near current lows but RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days, the daytime circulation mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises while TRANSIT falls, the city is moving into a stay-at-home regime that limits discretionary retail trips. In that regime, RETAIL_REC should underperform within one week and remain below the prior four-week mean unless transit mobility recovers first.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL exceeds +12 and TRANSIT is below -45
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays above +12 and TRANSIT stays below -45 but RETAIL_REC does not drop within 7 days, the stay-at-home mechanism fails.
